Open • FLYBYME (Tim) opened about 1 minute ago • 0 comments
Labels: bug


   describeExposure  (mesh-serve  src/api/schema/descriptor.ts ) builds a     
  complete                                                                    
  machine-readable description of every exposed call —  key ,  domain ,       
  action                                                                      
  ,                                                                           
   description ,  method ,  path ,  gate ,  input ,  output ,  destructive ,  
   stream ,  errors . It is consumed at build time to emit the typed client   
  and                                                                         
  then discarded.                                                             
                                                                              
  The browser gets method and path and nothing else, because  ApiCall.types   
  is a                                                                        
  phantom by design ( mesh-web/src/net/api.ts:33  — "Never assigned. Present  
  only                                                                        
  so the compiler carries the shapes.").                                      
                                                                              
  Two consequences, both live today:                                          
                                                                              
  1. The gate is a comment.  mesh-core/src/generated/api.ts  documents each   
  call as  auth: public . The console site's own row declares  auth: 'user'   
  for                                                                         
  all eighteen of its contracts except  identity.ticket_issue , and the server
  answers:                                                                    
                                                                              
    $ curl 'http://127.0.0.1:5005/api/parts?limit=2' -H 'Host: console.       
  localhost'                                                                  
    {"error":"UNAUTHENTICATED","message":"part.find requires a valid ticket."}
                                                                              
  So the one artifact a developer would read to find out whether a call needs 
  auth                                                                        
  says the opposite of the truth, and nothing can check it because the gate   
  never                                                                       
  becomes runtime data.                                                       
                                                                              
  2. No client can adapt to it. An Application cannot ask "does this call need
  a session?", so it cannot hold a request that is certain to 401, and cannot 
  know                                                                        
  to retry when a session appears.                                            
                                                                              
  See  mesh-web/spec/schema-driven-ui.md  §1 and §3.1, and roadmap B13.

Open • FLYBYME (Tim) opened about 2 minutes ago • 0 comments
Labels: bug


  Reported: "the first thing  mesh-core/src/catalog/index.ts  should do is    
  check                                                                       
  for auth if it needs it. nothing in that file tells me it needs auth. when i
  login it needs to be notified if it needs auth and then update."            
                                                                              
  All three halves of that are true.                                          
                                                                              
  Nothing declares it.  mesh-core/src/catalog/contract.ts:48  reads           
                                                                              
    export const NEEDS = needs('models', 'mesh', 'state', 'commands',         
  'windows', 'log');                                                          
    export const CONSUMES = consumes();                                       
                                                                              
  No  AUTH , no  consumes(AUTH) . The manifest — the thing that is supposed to
  make                                                                        
  a contribution's requirements visible — does not record that this           
  Application is                                                              
  unusable signed out.                                                        
                                                                              
  It fires anyway.  cx.models('part')  fetches during  start() . Signed out   
  every one of those is a guaranteed 401, so the first thing a person sees is 
   Failed to load catalog parts (http): ...  rather than a sign-in prompt.    
                                                                              
  And nothing retries.  AuthApi.session  is a  Signal<Session | null> , so the
  information is available and reactive — but no consumer is subscribed, so   
  signing                                                                     
  in leaves every collection sitting on the error it got before there was a   
  session. The page looks broken until it is reloaded by hand.                
                                                                              
  The gate-driven half of the fix (a collection knowing whether a call needs a
  session, rather than being told by hand) depends on #39. The declaration and
  the                                                                         
  reload-on-sign-in do not.
